title: Unimodality and log-concavity conjecture for Mather polynomials
statement:
Let $X=G/P$ be a cominuscule space and let $w\in W^P$. Write

$$
{c_{\operatorname{Ma}}}(X_w^P)=\sum_v a_{w,v}[X_v^P]
$$

and define the Mather polynomial by

$$
M_w(x)=\sum_v a_{w,v}x^{\ell(v)}.
$$

**Unimodality and log-concavity conjecture for Mather polynomials.** The polynomial $M_w$ has strictly positive coefficients and is unimodal. If in addition $G/P=\operatorname{Gr}(k,n)$, then $M_w$ is log concave. These properties are motivated by substantial calculations in all Lie types; the source gives no resolution status.
references:
**3 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2016–2020). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2004.13116](https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.13116), [arXiv:1604.02938](https://arxiv.org/abs/1604.02938).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.04842

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of June 2020). “A similar positivity conjecture was given in for the CSM classes and it was proved in the non-equivariant case in for Grassmannians and in general.”
source_name: Leonardo C. Mihalcea and Rahul Singh, “Mather classes and conormal spaces of Schubert varieties in cominuscule spaces”, arXiv:2006.04842 (2020).
